scope: Post-training fixed-confidence diagnostic on old sparse labels. Project12 source held out; all other three source clips were used in training, so those results measure fit/regression only, not unseen-video generalization. Labels are not independent. No threshold/model selection from this diagnostic.
matching: role-blind greedy by descending IoU for box fixtures or ascending foot distance for point fixtures, one-to-one
metrics: Correct role / labelled observations, confusion and misses; no precision/mAP from incomplete frames. Outside labels excluded from role denominators. All frames retained including camera cuts.
acceptance: Screening only; do not promote model from these development labels. Require independent, complete frames across multiple matches and resource budget before integration.
timing: CUDA batch1 FP32 defaults, synchronized end-to-end predict excluding decode and warmup; not full pipeline FPS. Architecture comparison is not size-fair. Peak allocated memory is process-only, not total VRAM.
